description_en: Queries the security operations trends for vulnerabilities, alerts, and baselines
description_zh: 查询漏洞、告警与基线的安全运营趋势
name: GetDataTrend

parameters.help_en:
The type of security data to query. Valid values:
HC_NEW: number of new baseline risks
HC_OPERATE: number of handled baseline risks
VUL_NEW: number of new vulnerability risks
VUL_OPERATE: number of handled vulnerability risks
SUSP_NEW: number of new alert risks
SUSP_OPERATE: number of handled alert risks
parameters.help_zh:
查询安全数据类型。取值：
HC_NEW：新增基线风险数
HC_OPERATE：已处理基线风险数
VUL_NEW：新增漏洞风险数
VUL_OPERATE：已处理漏洞风险数
SUSP_NEW：新增告警风险数
SUSP_OPERATE：已处理告警风险数
parameters.name: biz_types

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp of the query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp of the query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The interval for querying data. Unit: milliseconds.

Minimum value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据间隔。单位：毫秒。

最小值1000
parameters.name: interval

DateList.description_en: The list of statistical timestamps for the trend data
DateList.description_zh: 趋势数据的统计时间戳列表

items.description_en: The statistical timestamp for the trend data. Unit: seconds
items.description_zh: 趋势数据的统计时间戳。单位：秒

DateStrList.description_en: The list of statistical date strings for the trend data
DateStrList.description_zh: 趋势数据的统计时间日期列表

items.description_en:
The statistical date string for the trend data.

Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
items.description_zh:
趋势数据的统计时间日期。

格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

CountList.description_en: The list of statistical values for the trend data
CountList.description_zh: 趋势数据的统计值列表

items.description_en: The statistical value for the trend data
